caughtCarryingLoot.text: A lantern comes up full in your face. Down in the stacks, at night, with your arms full of things that aren't yours. The prefect takes them all, into a sack for the confiscation vault. The prefect behind the lantern looks less angry than tired.
caughtCarryingLoot.say: You run, and know every turn better than they do. You get away. You also know they saw your face.

firstPearl.text: The astronomy classroom's brass orrery is still turning, a century after anyone wound it, its planets on long arms going round and round in the dark. The smallest planet is a pearl. It would come off its arm, if you were quick, and the orrery wouldn't stop.
firstPearl.say: You time the arm, and the pearl is in your palm before it's gone round. The orrery doesn't notice. It goes on turning, one planet short.

repeatPearl.text: The orrery is still turning, one planet short where you took the pearl.
repeatPearl.say: Quick as a pickpocket, you lift the pearl as it passes. The little arm swings on, empty, keeping time.

recoveredBothBottles.text: At the bottom of the deep stacks, a door with a prefects' padlock and crates outside labelled for the confiscation vault. Behind it, three hundred years of everything the faculty ever took off a student. You've no idea what's where. Somewhere in there is the bottle the prefects took from your trunk.
recoveredBothBottles.say: The padlock gives. Your things are on a shelf with a label in a prefect's neat hand, your name spelled right. You take them back, and one small thing more for the trouble.

boardAfterSecondMiss.text: The bursar's clerk calls you back to the window and slides this month's board money across to you. "It's been paid," she says. "A gentleman in grey. He said he was family." The receipt isn't signed. Where the name should be there's a single thumbprint, white with frost.
boardAfterSecondMiss.say: You put the coins in your purse. They're cold, and they stay cold all month, and you find you spend them last.
rentSay: The bursar takes the board money with a nod and a tick in a very large book.
